title: Accept canonical complete living-report final status
description:
As an operator, I want a successfully published living optimization Report to reach a consistent terminal state, so that its cover content and dashboard lifecycle never disagree.

Feature: Living optimization Report finalization

Scenario: Canonical complete status finalizes a published Report
Given a living optimization Report has a durable final revision
When the orchestrator finalizes the run with status complete
Then the Report and Task are marked terminal without an exception
And the stored final status is canonical and consistent

Scenario: Unsupported terminal status remains rejected
Given a living optimization Report exists
When finalization receives an unknown status
Then finalization fails before changing the Report or Task

Excludes changes to score data, infrastructure resources, or Amplify schema.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Live acceptance published a complete final presentation revision, then rejected the caller's canonical complete status before closing the Report Task. The dashboard therefore showed complete report content under a running lifecycle header. Reproducing with an outside-in runtime test before changing production code.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Added an outside-in regression case for the canonical complete status and confirmed it failed against the live-path behavior. The smallest fix admits complete alongside the existing lifecycle spellings. Focused report and portfolio suites pass (47 tests), and the previously stranded synthetic Report Task now closes as COMPLETED with matching complete cover content in the dashboard. Keep open until the change lands.
